research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Mighty Buildings is advancing in the field of 3D printing by developing a photopolymer composite material designed for use in 3D printing systems. This material includes an acrylate oligomer, inorganic hydrate, reinforcing filler, and a UV initiator, which together enhance the structural integrity and sustainability of printed structures. This aligns with their focus on creating innovative housing solutions through automation and 3D printing technology.

overview_description.description:
Mighty Buildings is a cutting-edge construction technology company that uses 3D printing, robotics, and automation to build homes.

It is a modular construction company working on disrupting the residential housing market with 3D printing tech, robotics, and composite materials backed by notable top-tier venture capital firms. The company creates a proprietary building material called Light Stone Material (LSM) which is similar to a synthetic stone that can be 3D printed, making the building process faster and with zero waste. LSM can also maintain a structure’s temperature better than concrete, wood, or steel.

about_short_description.short_description: Mighty Buildings specializes in 3D printing and automation to produce sustainable and innovative housing solutions.

product.name: Mighty Kit System™
product.description: A prefabricated wall and building platform that combines 3D-printed panels, a structural steel frame, insulation, finishes, and installation hardware for residential and commercial construction.

product.name: LUMUS™ Material
product.description: A proprietary inorganic composite construction material used for 3D-printed building components and wall systems, providing structural performance, insulation support, and resistance to water, mold, mildew, insects, and fire.

product.name: Automated Offsite 3D-Printed Construction
product.description: Factory-based construction services that use robotic 3D printing, milling, insulation, and coating processes to manufacture building components and housing structures for developers, builders, and project partners.
